    level="1"
    right="Feat 4"

>
[Worm Sense](/Feats.aspx?ID=4358) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm](/Sources.aspx?ID=209) pg. 80

**Archetype** [Worm Caller](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=208)

**Prerequisites**
[Worm Caller Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4357)

</column>

---

You emulate the senses of the [cave worm](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=21). You gain [darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=415) and [tremorsense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=40) as an imprecise sense within 5 feet.

 The range of the tremorsense increases to 10 feet at 8th level and to 15 feet at 12th level.
